Tradition, Thoughtfully Kept

Built in a gentler era, and cared for ever since

Ridgewood was designed around its courtyards rather than its parking lot — low brick buildings, mature oaks, and balconies that look out over open lawn. Inside, warm wood cabinetry and generous windows carry the character of the era, kept up by a leasing team that works on site every weekday.

The Property

Designed for How You Actually Live

Practical comforts, kept in good order — the details that make a place easy to come home to.

See All Amenities

Utilities Included

Heat, water, trash, and sewer are all covered by your rent. Electric is the only bill you set up.

On-Site Parking

Resident parking steps from your own entrance, with garages available.

Private Balconies

Most homes open onto a private balcony or patio overlooking the courtyard lawn.

Laundry on Every Floor

Newly installed machines in an easily accessible room, all credit card operated — no coins to keep track of.

On-Site Management

A leasing team on the property every weekday for maintenance requests and questions.

Heat & Air Conditioning

Central heat, plus air conditioning available, keeping every home comfortable year-round.

Secure Entry

Locked building entrances with intercom access for your guests.

Classic Kitchens

Warm wood cabinetry and timeless finishes give every kitchen its own character.

Oak Courtyard Grounds

Mature oaks and maintained lawns between the buildings, cared for through every season.

The East Side

Life at the Edge of the City

A residential pocket of Saint Paul with parkland on one side and the Woodbury shopping corridor on the other — Target at the end of the block, six parks within ten minutes, and Whole Foods, Costco and Trader Joe’s not far past that.

Ball fields, a playground, and the rec center — a half mile up the street.
